entries.subject: DAMIT 271: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-271.txt. Model 271, version 2016-04-22, pole (334°, 39°), period 4.795168 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 7.4 ±0.2 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 272: pole (336°, 39°), 4.79517 h, version 2007-02-22. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.

entries.subject: Ivar thermophysical scale alternatives
entries.finding: The selected DAMIT 271 mesh keeps its 7.4 ± 0.2 km fixed-shape archive scale. Hanuš et al. (2015), Table 4, reports a wider varied-shape thermophysical result of 8.0 km with −0.9/+0.3 km bounds. The latter is not substituted onto this mesh; it shows that the selected archive error is not total physical-size uncertainty and supplies no local terrain constraint.
